title: More Than 100 AI Agents Audit a Company's Accounts.. and Ask Better Questions Than Humans! 🧾
body: More Than 100 AI Agents Audit a Company's Accounts.. and Ask Better Questions Than Humans! 🧾

Accounting firm KPMG has deployed more than 100 AI agents to examine the financial statements of an unnamed listed British company, in an experiment called "Project Exponential", running alongside the traditional audit team. The agents gathered, analysed, and documented the data and prepared draft conclusions, working independently together and suggesting next steps.

An audit is an independent examination of a company's accounts to verify that they are correct. In several cases, the AI dug deeper into issues than the human team and asked "better questions", according to the firm's head of audit. But human intervention was necessary: one agent failed to match a set of regulations against the company's documents, so a human auditor stepped in. The audit's official opinion was based on the traditional human work, not the experiment. The system was built in four months, and the company plans to expand it to up to 20 larger audits — but the technology is not yet ready for thousands of audits.
Would you trust an audit carried out by AI? 💼
